claims.text: Yes, the contract caps NETGEAR's total liability for damages under the Agreement. The cap amount is redacted in the source as [*], so the sources do not state the dollar figure. The cap is described as the amount paid to NETGEAR under the Agreement.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 14.A AND 16.A, IN NO EVENT WILL NETGEAR's OR BAY NETWORKS' TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: Damages arising under Section 14.A (Claims of Infringement, indemnification) and Section 16.A (Limitation of Liability, indemnification) are excluded from NETGEAR's cap.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 14.A AND 16.A

NETGEAR agrees to defend at its own expense any action brought against Distributor to the extent that it is based on a claim that any Product infringes a United States or Territory patent, copyright, trade mark, trade secret or other valid intellectual property right
NETGEAR agrees to indemnify Distributor against any claim arising out of or resulting from the Products or the Agreement

claims.text: The Distributor's liability is also capped at the same [*] amount, with exceptions for damages arising from breach of Sections 6.C, 12, 13, or 17. The source text reads 'WELL' where 'WILL' is presumably meant, and it is quoted as written.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING FROM BREACH OF SECTIONS 6.C AND 12,13 OR 17, IN NO EVENT WELL DISTRIBUTOR's TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: Separately from the cap, either party is excluded from liability for the cost of substitute procurement, special, indirect, incidental or consequential damages, and damages from inaccurate or lost data or loss of use or profits. The source states this applies 'EVEN IF INFORMED OF SUCH DAMAGES.' The source does not list carve-outs to this exclusion.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL EITHER PARTY OR THEIR RESPECTIVE PARENT CORPORATIONS OR SUPPLIERS BE LIABLE FOR (1) THE COST OF SUBSTITUTE PROCUREMENT, SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, OR (2) ANY DAMAGES RESULTING FROM INACCURATE OR LOST DATA OR LOSS OF USE OR PROFITS
